projects.title: Brand Intelligence OS
projects.headline: Evidence before intuition.
projects.intro: A local-first research system that turns scattered brand signals into a traceable working library.
projects.problem: Brand research gets fragmented across websites, social channels and advertising libraries. The challenge is preserving what was observed and where it came from.
projects.approach: The pipeline collects source material and retains raw Markdown, HTML, screenshots and failure records. Structured reports can then be developed from evidence rather than memory.
projects.value: Clearer evidence helps strategists compare brands, revisit sources and develop better-grounded questions.
projects.status: A documented research system. Blocked or unavailable sources remain explicit gaps; this portfolio does not claim exhaustive coverage.

projects.title: GST Invoice Studio
projects.headline: Less repetition. Better paperwork.
projects.intro: An India-focused workspace for invoices, purchase orders and reusable business records.
projects.problem: Small studios repeat the same client and service details across business documents, creating avoidable friction and inconsistency.
projects.approach: Reusable records feed document workflows, GST splits and A4 PDF output. Browser-local storage supports local work, with optional Supabase authentication and sync.
projects.value: Consultants and studios can prepare consistent paperwork with less repeated entry and clearer document structure.
projects.status: Repository-documented capabilities; tax settings and documents need business-specific review. No compliance certification is implied.

projects.title: Personal Brain OS
projects.headline: Give scattered thoughts a home.
projects.intro: A self-hosted cockpit connecting everyday capture with a Markdown knowledge base.
projects.problem: Notes, links, voice and photos often live in separate places. Capturing them is easy; making them useful later is harder.
projects.approach: Capture pipelines turn incoming material into structured Markdown for an Obsidian vault. A cockpit brings together daily work and human-reviewed relationship proposals.
projects.value: A consistent capture-to-knowledge workflow reduces fragmentation and makes personal context easier to revisit.
projects.status: A self-hosted personal system. Relationship changes remain human-reviewed; private notes and personal records are not published here.

projects.title: V/HOME
projects.headline: A calmer place to land.
projects.intro: An ad-free LG webOS launcher designed around a shared living room.
projects.problem: A television is a shared, distant screen controlled with a remote. App access and household information need a different interaction rhythm from a desktop.
projects.approach: Favorites, folders, HDMI inputs, wallpaper and household information share one launcher. V/TV Sleep provides the timer; a phone companion extends control.
projects.value: Households can reach familiar apps and shared information from one intentional home screen.
projects.status: Developer Mode required. Optional Home redirection is best-effort; model-specific behavior and setup limits are documented in the public repository.

projects.title: Chapter Admin
projects.headline: Make chapter work visible.
projects.intro: A chapter administration workspace for membership, meetings, attendance and finances.
projects.problem: Chapter operations span people, recurring meetings and money. Separate records make it harder to maintain a shared operational view.
projects.approach: Role-based access and isolated chapter workspaces organize membership, meeting attendance, dues and treasury records in one application.
projects.value: Administrators can coordinate recurring chapter work with clearer records and explicit access boundaries.
projects.status: Software workflow documented in the repository. Hardware attendance-device integration and measured deployment outcomes are not claimed.

projects.title: V / The studio identity
projects.headline: One practice. Many ways to build.
projects.intro: A personal identity joining brand strategy, design, consulting and software products.
projects.problem: An interdisciplinary practice can look fragmented when design work and technical work are presented as unrelated identities.
projects.approach: Bricolage Grotesque display type and Hanken Grotesk supporting text connect the portfolio. Indigo and teal define the public artwork in every browser theme; bone and pink serve the print profiles. Tonal blocks, dot grids and circular arrows follow the Design Innsaeit visual system.
projects.stack: Brand architecture / art direction / SVG / editorial systems
projects.value: Visitors can understand the breadth of the practice while following a consistent visual and narrative structure.
projects.status: This profile is the live identity application. Graphics are original vector studies; the V/HOME preview is labeled separately as an actual browser simulation.
